subject.title: Control UI: tool calls render as opaque JSON cards — no diffs, no purpose, unpaired parallel calls

question: Should this issue include model-generated tool-purpose titles and a new `chat.toolTitles` RPC, or should the first implementation remain deterministic and address pairing, summaries, and diffs only?
rationale: Current source proves the deterministic presentation and pairing defects, but generated titles introduce new gateway, provider, billing, privacy, fallback, and persistent-state policy that cannot be authorized from the bug evidence alone.

options.title: Deterministic First
options.body: Fix ID-based pairing, command/file labels, aggregate summaries, and inline diffs first, then evaluate with browser proof whether complex calls still need generated titles.

options.title: Approve Generated Titles
options.body: Include title generation only with an explicit protocol contract, shared utility-model selection, sensitive-data limits, cache invalidation, and failure behavior.

recommendation.title: Deterministic First
recommendation.body: Fix ID-based pairing, command/file labels, aggregate summaries, and inline diffs first, then evaluate with browser proof whether complex calls still need generated titles.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the recent grouped tool-activity design and opened this protected follow-up issue.
